Sarah — thanks, got the W-9. Quick note on process so we’re aligned: procurement needs vendor tax identity validated before we can route the PO to AP. Acceptable evidence in order of speed: (A) Notarized W-9 or matching bank letter, (B) Secure selfie video with OTP passcode + government ID on camera, (C) Documented upload to our secure vendor portal with metadata.

Proposed path to unblock faster: 1) Upload the signed W-9 to our secure intake link (one-time upload) so we have an immutable copy (I’ll share the portal link below). 2) If you prefer video KYC, record the short selfie video reading the following script: your full legal name, StudioFX Media, EIN, and today’s date; show the government ID for a few seconds; state the one-time passcode we will provide. 3) Share the secure link to the video (or bank letter). Once procurement confirms identity match, we’ll issue a PO number within 48 hours.

For traceability I’m looping in Lauren (procurement lead) and Ben (CS/sales) so they have the evidence and can confirm the PO SLA.

Portal (secure upload): https://secure-vendor.example.com/upload/one-time
HubSpot deal: https://hubspot.example.com/deals/DEAL-7789

If you send the video, please include the playback token file or the docusign envelope for the W-9 signature so we can attach it to the vendor record.

Thanks — I’ll hold the request open and we’ll aim for PO issuance by end of week once we have verification.

— David

Hi Sarah — welcome. A couple of procurement clarifications: plain email attachments are not sufficient for final PO activation because we need chain-of-custody and a way to match the EIN on the W-9 to the supporting proof. We will accept the selfie video option but it must meet these controls:

- Video must be uploaded to a secure link (no public hosting).
- Video must include a one-time passcode (we will generate) spoken aloud in the clip.
- Video must include view of a government-issued photo ID (front side) held beside the speaker's face.
- The W-9 PDF must be uploaded to the secure portal and match the name/EIN in the video.

If you prefer, we can accept a bank letter (on bank letterhead) confirming EIN and account holder name instead of the video. That route typically adds 3 business days.

I’m attaching the vendor KYC checklist for reference. Once evidence is received and verified we’ll set the vendor status to ACTIVE and create the PO.

Attachments: [vendor-kyc-checklist.pdf (procurement/process)]

Lauren Bishop
